summary: First-iteration test of Suno Library mobile app. Backend: 18/18 pytest cases passed (auth register/login/me, duplicate-email 409, 401 on unauth, library import insert+dedupe, list sort+projection, favorite toggle, favorites_only filter, delete single, delete all, user-scoping). Frontend (Expo web preview, 390x844): boot redirect to /(auth)/login works, auth-hero image renders, signup creates account and routes into tabs, Library tab shows vinyl empty state with 'Connect Suno' CTA, Library/Favorites/Account tab navigation works, Account tab shows the user's email. Sign-out invokes Alert.alert confirm which on RN-Web shows a browser confirm dialog; could not auto-confirm in Playwright, but the wiring (testID account-logout, logout() + router.replace) is correct and will work natively. Demo account demo@suno.app/demopass123 login also verified.

minor.issue: Uses deprecated @app.on_event("startup")/("shutdown"); FastAPI recommends the lifespan context manager. Non-blocking.

issues: RN-Web warns: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated; use boxShadow (login/signup cta, library cta, account avatar). Cosmetic web-only warning; native platforms still honour shadow*. Consider switching to boxShadow or wrapping in Platform.select.
RN-Web warns: props.pointerEvents is deprecated; use style.pointerEvents (likely emitted by expo-linear-gradient/Image). Non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) Migrate backend startup/shutdown hooks to FastAPI lifespan handler.
(Optional) Replace shadow* StyleSheet keys with boxShadow (or Platform-gate) to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
Sign-out on web uses RN Alert which renders as window.confirm — fine for native; if web parity matters, swap to a custom modal on web.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is single-file (332 lines) but well-structured; under the 700-line threshold.
EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL is the correct Expo convention for client-exposed env vars and is read via process.env in src/api/client.ts.
Mongo _id is properly excluded across all responses (projections {'_id': 0, ...}).
All interactive elements have testID. All text is wrapped in <Text>. Uses TouchableOpacity/Pressable correctly.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested smoke flows (5/5); sign-out confirm dialog skipped on web due to Alert API limitation, not a bug

seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates a transient user (test_<rand>@test.app) and cleans up its library; Playwright run created ui_<ts>@test.app with no library entries. demo@suno.app already exists from prior manual testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_suno_library_api.py — run with EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<preview-url> pytest backend/tests -v. It self-seeds users so it is safe to re-run repeatedly. Player screen and connect-suno WebView were NOT tested per main-agent instructions (cannot drive suno.com in this env).
